info.title: MycoLoop API
info.description:
Closed-loop mycology backend. Contract-first modular monolith: device gateway, validated telemetry, biology ledger, vision features, and a safety-constrained optimizer that may only recommend.

**Auth**: `X-API-Key` for operators, `X-Device-Token` for devices.

Response List Commands Devices  Device Id  Commands Get
Response Command Detail Commands  Command Id  Get
